scope: All p1-p22 numbered reductions, with p1-p19 complete 120-frame raw series and p20-p22 mapped to complete 96-frame bh/lh/lh2 raw series. Source tables and independent diffraction estimates are separate.
primary_series_policy: Use numbered run identities as the primary experimental organization. Prefer published Table S1 numeric observations for p1-p19; retain archived reduction variants and supplementary independent Ne checks. Do not substitute graph-only markers or weak/misindexed neon candidates.
published_uncertainty_semantics: Reported pressure width is the difference between before/after ruby readings per article; not relabelled as 1 sigma. Published volume widths are retained as printed, confidence unspecified.
profile_selection: Prefer uncapped profile when all three 200/220/311 Gaussian fits pass the same successful-fit, amplitude/residual >=3, no-bound, inter-reflection a spread <0.007 A guards. Otherwise try cap500, then cap200; preserve failures and all profiles. Selection does not use source pressure agreement.
independent_pressure_model: Fei et al. 2007 Vinet reference branch, V0=88.967 A^3 conventional four-atom fcc cell, K0=1.16 GPa, K0_prime=8.23. Small Fei MGD 300-to-293 K pressure correction applied.
qualification: Independent Ne estimates have no assigned experimental sigma or established absolute accuracy. Rejected automatic candidate conversions remain diagnostic details only and are absent from the public comparison CSV.
nominal_temperature_metadata: 293 K in every numbered reduction configuration; no independent thermometry recovered.
graph_mapping: Numbered p1-p22 and the 22 Figure 1 markers are different inventories. Graph-only nonambient markers near 5.93 and 44.53 GPa remain unmapped. The starting/S1 ambient candidate is separate from numbered p1-p22.
